decisions.statement: This module lands under node as the `vscode` an activation resolves.
A member content passes through keeps the value written into that member.
A tree item keeps the label that tree item was constructed with.
A tree view keeps the provider that tree view was created with.
A status bar item reads back the text assigned to that status bar item.
Every other member answers a proxy answering anything.
A proxy is a constructor only where the function behind that proxy is one.
A proxy hands back a fresh proxy.
A row written into a proxy is not there to read.
The reading is taken by asking each registered provider down its whole tree.
Nothing here judges the values drawn.
An extension reaches parts of the editor's interface no page here names.

definition: a `vscode` keeping what an extension draws into it, so a panel can be read back
